tools.name: sleekflow_list_contacts
tools.description: List contacts with their profile fields, labels and lists. Filter by phone, email or name. SleekFlow API: GET /api/contact.

tools.name: sleekflow_get_contact
tools.description: Get one contact by user profile id, with all profile fields. SleekFlow API: GET /api/contact/{userProfileId}.

tools.name: sleekflow_list_conversations
tools.description: List inbox conversations with status, assignee, channel and last update. Good first call to find open or unread chats. A repeat call within 1 second can return HTTP 400 'Server busy': wait 1 second, then call again. SleekFlow API: GET /api/conversation/all.

tools.name: sleekflow_get_conversation
tools.description: Get one conversation: contact, status, assignee and channel. SleekFlow API: GET /api/conversation/{conversationId}.

tools.name: sleekflow_list_messages
tools.description: List the messages of one conversation. Filter by time with start_timestamp and end_timestamp (Unix seconds). SleekFlow API: GET /api/conversation/message/{conversationId}.

tools.name: sleekflow_search_messages
tools.description: Search messages across all conversations by keyword, channel or status. SleekFlow API: GET /api/conversation/message/search.

tools.name: sleekflow_list_channels
tools.description: List the messaging channels connected to the account (WhatsApp, Messenger, LINE, WeChat, web and others). SleekFlow API: GET /api/conversation/channel.

tools.name: sleekflow_list_staff
tools.description: List staff members, optionally one team's members. SleekFlow API: GET /api/staffs.

tools.name: sleekflow_get_staff
tools.description: Get one staff member: name, role, status and teams. SleekFlow API: GET /api/staffs/{staffUserId}.

tools.name: sleekflow_list_teams
tools.description: List all teams in the account. SleekFlow API: GET /api/teams.

tools.name: sleekflow_get_team
tools.description: Get one team and its members. SleekFlow API: GET /api/teams/{teamId}.

tools.name: sleekflow_list_labels
tools.description: List the contact labels (hashtags) and their colors. SleekFlow API: GET /api/labels.

tools.name: sleekflow_list_contact_lists
tools.description: List contact lists (groups of contacts). SleekFlow API: GET /api/contact/list.

tools.name: sleekflow_get_contact_list
tools.description: Get one contact list and its details. SleekFlow API: GET /api/contact/list/{contactListId}.

tools.name: sleekflow_list_broadcasts
tools.description: List broadcast campaigns, optionally by name. SleekFlow API: GET /api/broadcasts.

tools.name: sleekflow_get_broadcast
tools.description: Get one broadcast campaign and its details. SleekFlow API: GET /api/broadcasts/{broadcastId}.

tools.name: sleekflow_get_broadcast_recipients
tools.description: List the recipients of one broadcast with their delivery status. SleekFlow API: GET /api/broadcasts/{broadcastId}/recipients.

tools.name: sleekflow_get_analytics
tools.description: Get conversation analytics data for a date range. SleekFlow API: GET /api/analytic.

tools.name: sleekflow_send_message
tools.description: Send a text message to a customer through a connected channel. The customer receives it: confirm the text and recipient first. Outside WhatsApp's 24-hour window only an approved template works. Phone numbers: international format, no '+'. SleekFlow API: POST /api/message/send/json.

tools.name: sleekflow_send_internal_note
tools.description: Add an internal note to a conversation. The customer does not see it. Optional staff_user_id posts the note as that staff member. SleekFlow API: POST /api/message/send/note.

tools.name: sleekflow_add_or_update_contacts
tools.description: Create contacts, or update them when the phone number already exists. Send one or more contacts. SleekFlow API: POST /api/contact/addOrUpdate.

tools.name: sleekflow_update_contact
tools.description: Change one contact's name, phone or email, or add and remove labels. Fields you leave out stay as they are. SleekFlow API: POST /api/contact/update/{userProfileId}.

tools.name: sleekflow_assign_conversation
tools.description: Assign a conversation to a staff member. Pass staff_id 'unassigned' to remove the assignee. SleekFlow API: POST /api/conversation/{conversationId}/assignee.

tools.name: sleekflow_add_contacts_to_list
tools.description: Add contacts to one contact list. SleekFlow API: POST /api/contact/list/{contactListId}/add.

tools.name: sleekflow_create_labels
tools.description: Create one or more contact labels with a color: blue, pink, yellow, green, red, purple, grey or cyan. SleekFlow API: POST /api/labels.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: sleekflow_list_contacts, sleekflow_list_conversations, sleekflow_list_messages, sleekflow_search_messages, sleekflow_add_contacts_to_list · Private data: sleekflow_list_contacts, sleekflow_get_contact, sleekflow_get_conversation, sleekflow_list_labels, sleekflow_list_contact_lists, sleekflow_get_contact_list, sleekflow_add_or_update_contacts, sleekflow_update_contact, sleekflow_add_contacts_to_list, sleekflow_create_labels · Public sink: sleekflow_list_contacts, sleekflow_list_broadcasts, sleekflow_get_broadcast, sleekflow_get_broadcast_recipients, sleekflow_send_message, sleekflow_send_internal_note, sleekflow_add_or_update_contacts, sleekflow_update_contact, sleekflow_assign_conversation, sleekflow_add_contacts_to_list, sleekflow_create_labels · Destructive: sleekflow_send_message, sleekflow_update_contact, sleekflow_assign_conversation.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: sleekflow_list_contacts, sleekflow_list_conversations, sleekflow_list_messages, sleekflow_search_messages, sleekflow_add_contacts_to_list · Private data: sleekflow_list_contacts, sleekflow_get_contact, sleekflow_get_conversation, sleekflow_list_labels, sleekflow_list_contact_lists, sleekflow_get_contact_list, sleekflow_add_or_update_contacts, sleekflow_update_contact, sleekflow_add_contacts_to_list, sleekflow_create_labels · Public sink: sleekflow_list_contacts, sleekflow_list_broadcasts, sleekflow_get_broadcast, sleekflow_get_broadcast_recipients, sleekflow_send_message, sleekflow_send_internal_note, sleekflow_add_or_update_contacts, sleekflow_update_contact, sleekflow_assign_conversation, sleekflow_add_contacts_to_list, sleekflow_create_labels · Destructive: sleekflow_send_message, sleekflow_update_contact, sleekflow_assign_conversation

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
